answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the atlas of a task receipt, and the delta is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the sable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
